svg.title: The PUGZ League
svg.desc: A league season runs from sign-ups and a placement weekend through seven weeks of matches to the semi-finals and Finals Night. Four divisions of eight teams: Division 1, open to every rank; Division 2, no ruby; Division 3, diamond 4 at most; Division 4, platinum 1 at most. Every division has a cash prize, highest in Division 1. The two finalists of each division move up, the bottom teams move down.
